paella: Valencian paella takes few ingredients and a lot of craft: chicken, rabbit, garrofó beans, bajoqueta, tomato, paprika, saffron, water, salt, olive oil and Valencia D.O. rice. At Yerga we cook it over orange-tree wood, which gives a lively heat and an aroma gas never will.
It is cooked to order for a minimum of two people. Choose your paella when you book and it will be just right, with its socarrat, when you sit down.
arroceria: Wood-fired Valencian rice dishes: Valencian paella, arròs a banda, senyoret, black rice, fideuà, oven-baked rice and creamy lobster rice.
Book online in under a minute: we only offer times with a genuinely free table, and you can pre-order your rice.
grupos: Company lunches, birthdays and family gatherings: we join tables, cook several paellas at once and agree a menu with sharing starters, rice, dessert and drinks.
For groups of more than ten, send us a request with the day and time; we'll confirm as soon as we review it.

grupos.texto: For groups we set up the room by hand: we join tables, pre-order the rice and agree a menu that suits you.
